hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.css) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && corepack pnpm exec prettier --write "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && out=$(corepack pnpm exec tsc -b 2>&1) || jq -n --arg o "$out" '{decision:"block", reason:("tsc failed — fix type errors before finishing:\n"+$o)}'
